h: Regina Daniels reportedly breaks her silence after a video of a heated exchange with her mother goes viral
p: Actress Regina Daniels has reportedly responded after a clip of a tense confrontation with her mother spread widely online. The video drew a flood of comments from fans, many of them divided over what the exchange meant. It comes amid months of public attention on her family and marriage.
more: The clip has been shared across Instagram and X, with fans taking sides.
Her mother has been in the headlines several times this year over family matters.
Neither side has given full details of what led to the exchange.
